steps.title: Analyze Language Detection Requirements
steps.description: Examine user's requests to dynamically detect spoken Hindi, English, and Hinglish/Roman Hindi commands in Popeen Voice Assistant.

steps.title: Formulate Hinglish & Hindi Keyword Dictionary
steps.description: Establish a set of core Roman Hindi/Hinglish vocabulary tokens to assist the classifier in identifying non-English speech patterns.

steps.title: Implement isHindiLanguage Classifier
steps.description: Create a specialized language analyzer verifying both Devanagari Unicode bounds and Roman Hindi token occurrences.

steps.title: Refactor User Command Router
steps.description: Intercept command intents inside processUserCommand to evaluate the input language dynamically prior to selecting responses.

steps.title: Adapt Time Response for Hindi and English
steps.description: Enable speakTimeResponse to accept the command's spoken language classification, mapping appropriate localized expressions.

steps.title: Adapt Unsupported Response for Localization
steps.description: Optimize speakUnsupportedResponse with contextual translation blocks for synchronized text rendering and speech playback.

steps.title: Enhance speakDirectly with Locale Overloads
steps.description: Implement an overloaded speakDirectly method accepting dynamic Locale instances for granular speech engine control.

steps.title: Integrate TTS Language Availability Verification
steps.description: Call textToSpeech.isLanguageAvailable(locale) before every speak operation to confirm engine support.

steps.title: Design Safe Graceful Fallbacks
steps.description: Create exception-safe structures mapping back to English (India) if specialized Hindi engines are unavailable or fail.

steps.title: Preserve Session Lifecycle and Settings Compatibility
steps.description: Verify that wake word detection, 10-minute active sessions, error restarts, and main preference fallbacks are maintained.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Language Specifications
steps.description: Check that all code modifications adhere to standard Java 8 guidelines, retaining backward-compatible structures.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Launch target Gradle validation sequence to verify functional compilation and deployment configurations.
